verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Mollie creating and sending hosted invoices to customers, and nothing documents automatic payment reminders. Payment links that can be 'attached to an unpaid invoice' are an adjacent feature, because the invoice itself would come from elsewhere. The 'Invoices API' and 'invoice creation' webhook events are only listed by name, with no description of customer-facing hosted invoicing or reminders.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
